response:
**Q3 planning summary:** The team needs to lock Q3 scope by **Friday, Aug 29**, so Sara can take it to **exec review on Monday**. The main decisions were to make the **reconciliation revamp a Q3 anchor**, ship **mobile receipt capture v1 without bulk-select**, and do a **go/no-go follow-up on the vendor payout SLA work** after more analysis.

**Key decisions and discussion**
1. **Reconciliation revamp**
   - Current system is struggling with **multi-currency batches**, with **3 incidents this quarter** and **reconciliation support tickets up 40% QoQ**.
   - Engineering estimated a rewrite at **~6 engineer-weeks**, including migration of the **FX rounding module**.
   - The work also needs **Karim from Platform for 2 weeks** for ledger integration.
   - Vendor options were reviewed, but both were unattractive:
     - **Recur:** ~$180K/year plus integration effort
     - **LedgerFlow:** ~$140K/year but missing required jurisdiction-specific tax code support
   - **Decision:** Build internally; reconciliation becomes a **Q3 anchor initiative**.

2. **Mobile receipt capture**
   - Design flows are complete and a prototype was tested with **6 users**.
   - Two main findings:
     - Users want **bulk-select receipts before upload**
     - The **OCR confidence indicator** needs to be much more prominent
   - Bulk-select would likely cost **about one sprint** and would require descope elsewhere.
   - **Decision:** Ship **v1 without bulk-select** and treat it as a **fast-follow roadmap item**.

3. **Vendor payout SLA**
   - Finance wants payouts guaranteed within **48 hours of invoice approval**.
   - Current performance is **71 hours at p95**.
   - Identified bottlenecks:
     - **Manual approval routing** on the Ops side
     - **ACH batching window** on the Engineering side
   - Proposed path to reach target by **mid-Q3**:
     - Reduce ACH batching window from **12 hours to 4**
     - Add a **second approver on the West Coast shift**
   - Engineering noted this is feasible but not free: about **half a sprint** plus **SRE sign-off** because more ACH runs mean more monitoring overhead.
   - **Decision:** Marcus and Jenna will bring back a **trade-off analysis next week**; if SRE confirms the monitoring load is manageable, the team proceeds, otherwise they will consider an intermediate target.

4. **Other planning notes**
   - **Audit-log retention update** is pushed to **Q4**, confirmed with Legal.
   - **Internal admin-tool refresh** remains with the intern team; no scope changes.

5. **Team/ops note**
   - HR flagged a spike in **bug-bash burnout** on the engineering side.
   - Marcus will prepare a **rotating on-call proposal** by **Aug 31**.

**Action items**
| Owner | Action | Due |
|---|---|---|
| Priya | Circulate Q3 scope draft for review | Thursday morning |
| Priya / team | Lock Q3 scope | Friday |
| Sara | Present at exec review | Monday |
| Marcus | Confirm Karim’s availability with his manager | This week |
| Marcus | Prepare ACH batching/SLA trade-off analysis | Next week |
| Jenna | Partner with Marcus on ACH/SLA analysis | Next week |
| Dan | Update mobile receipt-capture specs | Wednesday |
| Marcus | Propose rotating on-call structure to address burnout | Aug 31 |

**Net outcome:** Q3 is centered on **reconciliation**, **mobile receipt capture ships in a narrower v1**, and the **48-hour payout SLA** is still under evaluation pending operational and SRE trade-off analysis.
